name: auth-flows
description: Email verification and password reset on top of the gpp API packs' own register/login (FastAPI, Express on PostgreSQL or MySQL), with Next.js pages
features: Email verification: the API emails a link after the pack's POST /auth/register; POST /auth/verify-email, /auth/resend-verification
Password reset: POST /auth/forgot-password (same answer for unknown emails) and /auth/reset-password
GET /auth/verification-status and users.email_verified_at; require_verified_email (FastAPI) / requireVerifiedEmail (Express) for routes that need it
Single-use, expiring tokens with 32 random bytes, stored as SHA-256 hashes and checked in constant time
A reset retires other reset links; on Express it also revokes the user's refresh tokens
Alembic migration (FastAPI) or Prisma schema patch plus migration (Express, PostgreSQL and MySQL)
Email via Resend, SendGrid or AWS SES; development logs emails to the console without keys
Next.js pages (/verify-email, /forgot-password, /reset-password), /api/auth proxy routes and a verify-email banner
Secure credential storage for Tauri desktop apps (OS keychain via keyring)
Tauri IPC commands, login and register forms (desktop part is Tauri-only; Electron apps are skipped)
note: Add-ons are installed via 'gpp add' command, not 'gpp template install'. They add files to existing platform directories. See README.md.
